'''Ramontalonas Epic Senate''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''Player:''' [[Ramontalonas]]
* '''Published:''' 8 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
